subject: Service event: timeline, verification playbook, and next steps for AtlasPay
messages:
From: Kira Morales <kira@atlaspay.com>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.ai, support@redwood.ai
Cc: devops@atlaspay.com
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Intermittent inference timeouts impacting payment flow

Hi Aisha,

We started seeing intermittent inference timeouts hitting our /v1/generate endpoint around 07:10 PT this morning. User payment flows are intermittently failing (tokenization step times out, then payment fails). We observed an increase in 504s from ~0.1% baseline to ~4% between 07:10 and 07:45. We rolled traffic to a fallback region to mitigate at 07:50 but would like a full RCA and confirmation that the root cause is understood and won't recur.

Can you share the timeline, immediate mitigations you applied, and concrete next steps we should expect (including verification steps we can run from our side)? This is high priority for us — we have a paused deploy until we get assurance.

Thanks,
Kira Morales
Senior SRE, AtlasPay
attachments: none
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Kira Morales <kira@atlaspay.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, support@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intermittent inference timeouts impacting payment flow

Kira —

Thanks for the report and the initial metrics — really appreciate the quick details. We saw the same signal on our side and pushed an emergency mitigation at 07:40 PT that routed AtlasPay traffic to a hot standby pool and temporarily increased per-customer concurrency limits to reduce queueing. That action reduced user-facing 504s by 95% within five minutes.

High-level next steps:
- I will lead an RCA and follow up with a written summary by Thursday 11/5.
- Vivek will own a short-term configuration guard and monitoring adjustments (cc'd).
- Hannah will coordinate a verification playbook for your SREs and run a joint verification session next week.

I'll send the RCA draft with timeline and action items once we complete the log correlation and kernel selection traces.

Apologies for the disruption — we know this impacts your payments flow.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Customer Reliability Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Kira Morales <kira@atlaspay.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, support@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: AtlasPay post-incident RCA, timeline, and verification playbook

Kira / AtlasPay team —

Attached is the post-incident RCA PDF and verification playbook (also mirrored here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AtlasPay-RCA-20261105). Summary below; full details are in the attachment.

Executive summary (TL;DR)
- Incident window: 2026-11-01T07:10:00-07:50:00 PT (primary customer impact until failover at 07:50).
- Impact: 3.6–4.2% 504 rate on AtlasPay traffic during the window; median latency spike from 45ms to 420ms for tokenization calls.
- Root cause: a regresssion in our model serving kernel-selection logic combined with a conservative autoscaler threshold. The kernel selector elected a slower quantized execution path for a small subset of long-context requests; this increased per-request GPU time and amplified queueing. Concurrently, the autoscaler did not scale quickly enough due to a metrics aggregation bug (delayed rolling-average). The combination produced head-of-line queueing and eventual timeouts.

Timeline (condensed)
- 07:08 PT: Upstream probe shows modest latency fluctuation on long-context requests.
- 07:10 PT: AtlasPay begins to see elevated 504s; internal alert fires for elevated 5xx on route atlaspay-prod.
- 07:18 PT: Kernel-selection traces collected; small fraction of requests are routed to quantized kernel with higher per-token cost for the observed prompt shapes.
- 07:30 PT: Autoscaler rolling average lag detected in metrics pipeline (delay of ~90s), preventing an earlier scale event.
- 07:40 PT: Emergency mitigation — route AtlasPay to hot standby pool (manual routing override); increase concurrency limit per-customer.
- 07:45 PT: 504s reduced significantly.
- 07:50 PT: Full failover to standby region completed; traffic stable.

Immediate fixes applied
- Hotfix: Reverted kernel-selection change that caused misclassification of prompt shapes (deployed 09:20 UTC, 11/1).
- Autoscaler metrics patch: fixed aggregation window bug and added a conservative secondary trigger to avoid lag (deployed 11/2).
- Alerting: New alert for kernel misclassification rate and autoscaler lag.

Action items and owners
- VIVEK KULKARNI: Deliver a permanent fix to kernel-selection ML heuristic and add unit/regression tests (ETA 11/15).
- HANNAH SCHMITT: Publish verification playbook and run joint verification with AtlasPay SREs (ETA session week of 11/8; playbook attached).
- AISHA RAHMAN: Provide payment-flow specific validation queries and monitor for residual error rates for 30 days (ownership: ongoing).
- INFRA TEAM: Add autoscaler synthetic probes to detect aggregation lag earlier (ETA 11/12).

Verification playbook (high level)
- Step 1: Run our synthetic load script pointing at your tokenization route (playbook attached: atlaspay-verification-playbook-20261105.md).
- Step 2: Collect and share a 10-minute trace (we'll provide a trace collection command) so we can validate kernel paths.
- Step 3: Validate that 99th percentile latency returns to baseline under 2x usual peak traffic.
- Step 4: Confirm no increased 5xx over a rolling 30-minute window post-verification.

Attachments: atlaspay-rca-20261105.pdf (full RCA), atlaspay-verification-playbook-20261105.md (scripts & commands).

Compensation / commercial note
We understand the severity for payment flows. Our account team will follow up regarding credits for the impacted window; I’ve looped support in the thread.

Next meeting
Can we schedule a 30-minute verification session on Monday 11/8 at 09:00 PT? Hannah will coordinate a calendar invite if that works.

Thanks again for the patience — we own this and will communicate updates proactively.

Best regards,
Aisha Rahman
Customer Reliability Lead, Redwood Inference

Aisha / team —

Thanks for the detailed RCA and the playbook. We reviewed the attachment and the proposed verification steps. Monday 11/8 09:00 PT works for our SREs; please send the invite. We'll run the synthetic load and share traces as requested.

Two quick asks before the session:
1) Can you include the exact trace-collection command in the invite body so we can prep host access?
2) Can you confirm the rollback window plan in case the verification run reveals residual instability?

Appreciate the clear owners and timeline — looking forward to the verification session.

Kira
Senior SRE, AtlasPay
